## Marivell v1.2.0-beta.1

This is a preview release for broader testing. It focuses on large-document performance, scroll stability, and visual-mode regressions.

### Highlights

- Improved large-file opening, scrolling, jump recovery, and inline formula hydration.
- Reduced residual placeholders and scroll drift during large jumps and sustained drag plus wheel scrolling.
- Stabilized source/visual mode switching, selection mapping, history, export hydration, and caret alignment.
- Rebuilt the table editing entry as one contextual text menu to avoid toolbar overflow.
- Constrained wide tables inside a horizontal scroller and added rendering-boundary regression coverage.
- Removed the legacy vector icon fallback; toolbar controls now use only the custom icon assets.
- Unified document loading with the mode-switch overlay animation.

### Known Limitations

Large-document hard stability gates pass, but several soft performance targets still need work: typing latency, sustained scroll frame time, and long-distance jump-ready time may exceed the final release budget on very large documents.

### Downloads

- Windows: `Marivell.Setup.1.2.0-beta.1.exe`
- Linux: `Marivell-1.2.0-beta.1.AppImage` or `marivell_1.2.0-beta.1_amd64.deb`
